Nadia, Gideon ended up at **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his Jul 1 update in #strategic-pod. He first posted 300. A few minutes later he corrected it, saying the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The production roster showed 280 active seats as of Jul 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280 in the thread.

That's the July figure only. I didn't check whether the count changed after Jul 1.
